question: Determine which three lowest-level Reactome pathways (with TAS evidence) have the highest chi-squared statistics, considering only Homo sapiens targets associated with sorafenib under the conditions that the median assay value is ≤ 100 and both low and high assay values are ≤ 100 or null. For each of these three pathways, how many of these targets and non-targets lie within the pathway and outside it?
sql:
WITH sorafenib_targets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    LEFT JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    WHERE i.drugID = 157 AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND (e.exp_assayValueMedian IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100)
),
all_tas_pe_pathway AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe.pe_stable_id, pe.pathway_stable_id, pe2.uniprot_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pe.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe2 ON pe.pe_stable_id = pe2.stable_id
    WHERE pe.evidence_code = 'TAS' AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
),
all_tas_pe_uniques AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id, uniprot_id
    FROM all_tas_pe_pathway
),
pathway_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        atp.pathway_stable_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atp.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN atp.pe_stable_id END) as targets_within,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atp.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN atp.pe_stable_id END) as non_targets_within
    FROM all_tas_pe_pathway atp
    GROUP BY atp.pathway_stable_id
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_targets,
        SUM(CASE WHEN uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_non_targets
    FROM all_tas_pe_uniques
),
pathway_chi AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.pathway_stable_id,
        pc.targets_within as a,
        tc.total_targets - pc.targets_within as b,
        pc.non_targets_within as c,
        tc.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_within as d,
        tc.total_targets + tc.total_non_targets as n,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(
            (tc.total_targets + tc.total_non_targets) * 
            POWER((pc.targets_within * (tc.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_within) - 
                   (tc.total_targets - pc.targets_within) * pc.non_targets_within), 2),
            (pc.targets_within + (tc.total_targets - pc.targets_within)) * 
            (pc.non_targets_within + (tc.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_within)) * 
            (pc.targets_within + pc.non_targets_within) * 
            ((tc.total_targets - pc.targets_within) + (tc.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_within))
        ) as chi_squared
    FROM pathway_counts pc
    CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
)
SELECT 
    pc.pathway_stable_id,
    p.name as pathway_name,
    ROUND(pc.chi_squared, 2) as chi_squared,
    pc.a as targets_within,
    pc.b as targets_outside,
    pc.c as non_targets_within,
    pc.d as non_targets_outside
FROM pathway_chi pc
JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pc.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
ORDER BY pc.chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3
